qa_pairs.user_input: What was the root cause of the April 14, 2025 production outage and which DevOps engineer's config change in February is connected to it?

qa_pairs.user_input: Is the current NovaTech deployment checklist the v1 or v2 version, and what was the key difference from the old process?

qa_pairs.user_input: Summarize the key findings and recommended actions from the INC-2025-0187 incident report.
qa_pairs.reference: INC-2025-0187 was a Severity 1 production outage on April 14, 2025, lasting 2 hours 34 minutes. Root cause: autoscaler cooldown misconfigured to 3600s instead of 300s, causing the cluster to scale down during the HealthFirst onboarding traffic spike. Impact: ~1,240 users affected, 87,450 failed API requests, ~$47,000 revenue loss, SLA breach for 3 enterprise clients. Key action items: (1) Fix autoscaler cooldown and add CI validation; (2) Require peer review for infra config changes; (3) Add cluster-size alerts; (4) Run load tests for Tier-1 client onboardings; (5) Send SLA credit notices to affected clients. Post-mortem completed April 18, 2025.

qa_pairs.user_input: Summarize the access control and authentication requirements all NovaTech employees must comply with.
qa_pairs.reference: All NovaTech employees must: (1) Use MFA for all internal systems, VPN, and cloud consoles — mandatory, no exceptions; (2) Use VPN (WireGuard) for all remote access to internal resources; (3) Use passwords of minimum 14 characters with complexity requirements, not reused from last 12 passwords; (4) Service account API keys must be rotated every 90 days; (5) SSH keys must use ED25519 or RSA-4096 minimum. Principle of least privilege applies — employees receive only minimum required permissions, reviewed quarterly. Violations may result in disciplinary action.
